findings.title: Route rule gives every backend weight 0
findings.cause: rule 1 of HTTPRoute shop sends traffic to storefront, storefront-v2, all with weight 0, so the Gateway sends none of them a request and answers each request the rule matches with an HTTP 500

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-route-zero-weights -o jsonpath='{.spec.rules[0].backendRefs}'

findings.fix: Give at least one backend of rule 1 a weight above 0 (leaving weight out means 1); to take a backend out of service, remove it from the rule.
